name: Why shouldn't I demolish my shower as a DIY project?

mainEntity.name: Why shouldn't I demolish my shower as a DIY project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tearing out a shower without professional help carries serious risks, including ruptured plumbing lines, accidental electrical wire strikes inside walls, and severe structural damage from improper pry-bar use. Additionally, tile demolition generates airborne silica dust and sharp shards, requiring proper protective gear and HEPA-filtered containment. Hidden moisture damage or weakened subflooring can also go unnoticed without experienced trade inspection, leading to costly complications when installing new finishes later.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY demolition risks punctured supply lines, electrical hazards, hidden rot oversight, and heavy silica dust exposure without proper tools and site containment.
